reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: It’s a great concept, but it’s not easy to use. Once I entered my dose, I could never find where to change it. It wasn’t subtracting my dose from my supply, and it never increased the estimated amount in my system. It also won’t let me log a dose in mg if my supply is entered in units. Has a few things to fix, but I’m sure they’re in the works.

reviews.title: Not worth it. Waste of money.
reviews.text:
I just downloaded the app I saw good things about being able to log my doses and schedule. I am new to injecting and thought this would be an amazing app for a beginner. 

NOPE. DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY. JUST USE YOUR NOTES APP AND GOOGLE SAVE $20

There are so many bugs verbiage is not good. It’s difficult to log multiple peptides and it doesn’t even tell you what’s wrong or why you can’t. If you mess up on a dose oh well you can’t go back and fix it. 

I was stupid to pay for a subscription for this. and want my money back. I’ve spent about 2 hours in this app trying to figure it out. 

It doesn’t teach out anything you’re better off just logging it in your notes app on your phone. ChatGPT was more beneficial than this app. 

all of the information your paying money for can very easily be found with a google search. for $20 I was expecting it to give me information on my peptides, help me understand the configurations better, and understand the conversions. if anything it made it more confusing.
